captions.text: Stop sending the same resume to every job.
Let AI tailor it, without making anything up.
Pick a job, and tap tailor resume.
Then choose one of the built-in templates.
The AI picks what to lead with, using only your own experience.
Anything it can't verify goes back to your own words.
Then see exactly what it changed, and the reason for every change.
Edit any line, export to Word or PDF, and you're ready to apply.
Get it on the Microsoft Store.
